context.why: Third story of FS-030. Accepted so far: US1 (LocatedRecord fields on Sample and Measurement, Organization.location point, the location input, Point removed; Dataset.bbox temporarily aggregates the samples' points, decisions D17) and US3 (MeasurementQuerySet.with_effective_location(user) and Measurement.effective_location_for(user), the visibility rule written once in the annotation). This story builds the lookups and spatial coverage (plan D4, D5, D6) and the collection-table changes (plan D7): LocatedQuerySet mixin in fairdm/contrib/location/managers.py with inside(area), within_distance(point, distance), nearest(point) for samples and organizations; the measurement versions take user=None and use the effective location, with inside() as the union of two pk__in subqueries (own location covered; or no own location and sample visible to the viewer and covered) so each uses its own spatial index; fairdm/contrib/location/coverage.py with Coverage and spatial_coverage handling the 180th meridian via Extent and Extent over ST_ShiftLongitude, keeping the narrower box (west > east when it crosses); Dataset.spatial_coverage(user=None) narrowing samples AND measurements by visible_to(user); Project.spatial_coverage(user=None) over datasets the viewer may open; Dataset.bbox removed and the DataCite template switched over in US7 (for now point the template at spatial_coverage with no viewer, or leave a minimal change so tests stay green — US7 owns the DataCite tests). Collection tables: SampleTable latitude/longitude not orderable; MeasurementTable on the annotated effective_location; the collections view annotating measurement querysets with with_effective_location(request.user); the registry table factory leaving out any GeometryField (by type, not name).
prior_decisions: D1: a location is a value on each record, never a shared row. No Location model, no get_or_create.
D2: Organization holds a plain point, a Person holds none. Contributor.location is removed.
D8: no data migration — existing Point data is not carried across.
D12: field names are location, location_elevation, location_uncertainty.

FR-009: a sample type shows the location input only when its registration's fields list location. The demo's RockSample registration is to list location (as the approved prototype did); WaterSample does not.

D3 (decisions): a measurement falls back to its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample (Sample.objects.visible_to(user)); for anyone else a measurement with no location of its own has none.
D16: location constraints are listed in each concrete model's own Meta (location_constraints()), not on LocatedRecord.Meta.

D13: geometry column in SRID 4326; area lookups use location__coveredby (edge counts as inside); distance lookups cast to geography and use the geography GiST indexes already declared in US1 (sample_location_geog_idx, measurement_location_geog_idx, organization_location_geog_idx). The cast expression in the lookups must match the index expression exactly.

D15 watch item (ARCH-005): nearest() may order by Distance; switch to the <-> KNN operator only if T016's query plan shows a sequential scan for inside or within_distance (nearest ordering is not in SC-005).
SEC-002: coverage counts only what the viewer may open, measurements included, and a measurement placed only by a hidden sample contributes nothing.
Existing issue #510 (visible_to ignores project visibility) is out of scope: build on visible_to as it is.
Do not build the API field, import/export columns, organization forms or the DataCite tests: later stories.

acceptance.given_when_then: Given samples and organizations at known places, inside(box) and inside(polygon) return exactly those inside, edge included; within_distance in metres and D(km=) returns exactly those within, correct at the equator and at 70N; nearest orders by distance and carries it; each combines with visible_to().
Measurements: own location wins over the sample's; a measurement with none is found by its sample's location only for a viewer who may open the sample.
With 2,000 located samples (and organizations, and measurements for each inside branch) and ANALYZE run, EXPLAIN of inside and within_distance shows an index scan, not a sequential scan of the table.

Dataset coverage holds every visible location and is None with none; locations within 5 degrees either side of the 180th meridian give a box under 10 degrees wide with west > east; project coverage holds its datasets'; hidden records, including measurements placed by a hidden sample, do not count. The existing bbox test is replaced.
LocatedQuerySet, the measurement lookups, coverage.py, Dataset.spatial_coverage and Project.spatial_coverage exist per plan D4-D6; Dataset.bbox is removed and nothing reads it.

Collection tables show latitude under Latitude and longitude under Longitude, have no location link column, a measurement row shows its effective location for the viewer, and sorting by another column still works; the table factory leaves out geometry fields.
locations.md documents the lookups and spatial coverage with examples that run; CONTEXT.md defines Spatial coverage.
